# Scovant Core ↔ AgentReady v1.0

AgentReady (<https://agentready.org/>, v1.0, MIT) defines requirements, not weights: scoring belongs to scanners, and Scovant Core reproduces no third-party score. This page lists which AgentReady requirements Scovant Core checks measure, and how faithfully. It is regenerated by `python -m scovant_core.docs --standards` — do not hand-edit.

Summary: 18 requirements; 12 measured by Core checks (2 exact, 7 partial, 3 superset); 5 not measured by Core; 1 not applicable to a passive scanner.

## Relationship legend

| Relationship | Meaning |
|---|---|
| EXACT | The check's evidence is the requirement's evidence. |
| PARTIAL | The check measures a narrower slice; the gap is in the notes. |
| SCOVANT_SUPERSET | Core checks strictly more than the requirement asks. |
| AGENTREADY_ONLY | Core does not measure this requirement. |
| NOT_APPLICABLE | Not a website signal a passive scanner can read. |

## Mapping

| AgentReady | Tier | Title | Core checks | Relationship | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AR-FIND-01 | MUST | Block no agent/crawler access | CORE-ACCESS-002, CORE-ACCESS-003, CORE-ACCESS-008 | PARTIAL | robots.txt syntax, AI search crawler policy and indexability; network-layer blocking is observed only by Scovant Cloud. |
| AR-FIND-02 | SHOULD | Publish answers on canonical docs | — | AGENTREADY_ONLY | Whether canonical docs answer questions is a content judgement Core does not make. |
| AR-FIND-03 | SHOULD | List pages in sitemap.xml | CORE-ACCESS-005, CORE-ACCESS-006 | SCOVANT_SUPERSET | Sitemap presence and robots.txt reference, plus freshness. |
| AR-READ-01 | MUST | Answer in initial HTML | CORE-OPERABILITY-001 | EXACT | Server-rendered core content in the initial HTML. |
| AR-READ-02 | MUST | Accurate HTTP status codes | CORE-OPERABILITY-004 | PARTIAL | Broken machine-consumable endpoints; soft-404 and 429 + Retry-After validation are not yet checked. |
| AR-READ-03 | SHOULD | Homepage as raw HTML + links | CORE-OPERABILITY-001, CORE-TRUST-001, CORE-TRUST-007 | PARTIAL | Raw HTML plus discoverable contact and pricing links; docs/product link coverage is not measured. |
| AR-READ-04 | SHOULD | Docs answer user tasks | — | AGENTREADY_ONLY | Docs task coverage is a content judgement Core does not make. |
| AR-READ-05 | SHOULD | Fenced, language-tagged code | — | AGENTREADY_ONLY | Core does not parse code blocks. |
| AR-READ-06 | SHOULD | Link discovery files from content | CORE-OPERABILITY-007, CORE-INTERFACE-009 | PARTIAL | Machine reference integrity and agent discovery surfaces (both experimental); footer/metadata link placement is not measured. |
| AR-READ-07 | SHOULD | Ship llms.txt | CORE-ACCESS-009 | SCOVANT_SUPERSET | Presence, well-formedness and link integrity of llms.txt. |
| AR-READ-08 | SHOULD | JSON-LD on key pages | CORE-MACHINE-001, CORE-MACHINE-002, CORE-MACHINE-003 | SCOVANT_SUPERSET | JSON-LD parseability plus Organization and WebSite/WebPage entities on sampled pages. |
| AR-READ-09 | MAY | Markdown mirror via Link header | — | AGENTREADY_ONLY | Markdown mirrors via Link header are measured by Scovant Cloud's content-negotiation probe, not by Core. |
| AR-ACT-01 | SHOULD | Agent-completable auth | CORE-INTERFACE-006, CORE-INTERFACE-007 | PARTIAL | OAuth authorization-server and protected-resource metadata presence; the auth flow itself is verified only by Scovant Cloud. |
| AR-ACT-02 | SHOULD | API described in OpenAPI | CORE-INTERFACE-005 | EXACT | OpenAPI discovery at conventional paths or linked from the entry page. |
| AR-ACT-03 | SHOULD | MCP server at /mcp | CORE-INTERFACE-001, CORE-INTERFACE-002 | PARTIAL | MCP discovery file and declaration quality; the /mcp handshake is performed only by Scovant Cloud. |
| AR-ACT-04 | MAY | MCP server card | CORE-INTERFACE-009 | PARTIAL | MCP server cards are one of the agent discovery surfaces (experimental). |
| AR-ACT-05 | MAY | MCP Apps UI view | — | NOT_APPLICABLE | An MCP Apps UI view is not a website signal a passive scanner can read. |
| AR-ACT-06 | SHOULD | SDKs and CLI | — | AGENTREADY_ONLY | SDK and CLI availability is not a website signal Core measures. |
